rows.text: The Bureau's official English translation cover prints 'Shura Council Law, Royal Decree No. A/91, March 2, 1992'. The consolidated text gives Article 3 as a chairman and 150 members with women at least 20 per cent, and its Article 10 covers the Chairman, Vice Chairman, Assistant Chairman and Secretary General.

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair). Appointment orders, stated effective days, stated first days in office, oaths, council-formation orders, term starts and openings, acting presiding, deaths, translations, republications and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-06 king, crown-prince and prime-minister roles are outside this extract.
